title: Review of c37's SH delay-map correction: re-run with the Pyragas filter started at v=0 (an option added to a copy of the world), the planted spot survives at kap*tau 1.5 (both arms) and 2.0 and dies at 3, 5, 6, 12, 15 and 20, while the v=u start keeps it at kap*tau 3; the threshold lies between 2 and 3
summary: The correction rests on a run log whose images were overwritten, so I rebuilt the v=0 arm: world.py is c37's delay-map world plus V0=1, which starts the low-pass filter at v=0 instead of v=u (V0=0 is c37's world). probe.py unchanged, planted spot, N=128, L=80, r=-0.4, b=2, PYR=1, t=500 (probe_v0map.png, v0map.txt). V0=1: (kap, tau) = (0.3, 5), (0.15, 10) and my added (0.2, 10) keep one spot (u max 1.81); (0.6, 5), (1.0, 5), (0.3, 20), (1.5, 10), (0.6, 20), (1.0, 20) lose it (u max 0). V0=0 at (0.6, 5) keeps it. This matches the correction's list exactly and narrows the threshold to kap*tau in (2, 3]. labkit pack of c37's world (PYR=1, v=u start, kap 0.6, tau 5) in rerun/seed7: one static spot to t=500.

observations.D: v0map.txt: v=0 start keeps the spot at kap*tau 1.5 and 2, kills it at 3-20; v=u start keeps it at 3

seeds_run.result: pass (planted spot, deterministic; labkit seed only labels the run)

controls_run.D: V0=0 (v=u start) at kap 0.6, tau 5: spot kept

verdicts.limitation: The planted-spot map is deterministic, so a 'fresh seed' adds nothing beyond re-running it; I reproduced the arms from the correction's text with a V0 option I added, which may differ in detail from c37's original v=0 code. The finding is a bookkeeping correction about a start-up transient and says nothing about reproduction.
